rationale: Organization egress policy denies all container-registry blob CDNs (403 on CONNECT to production.cloudfront.docker.com and pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com), so the P3E Dockerfile's digest-pinned base images cannot be pulled and gates C2 and C4-C19 have never executed. P3F obtains the same images through an approved internal registry mirror rather than by relaxing egress policy or by substituting a different image.

rejected_alternatives.option: allowlist the upstream registry blob CDNs for CI
rejected_alternatives.reason: widens organization egress policy; not the ratified route

rejected_alternatives.option: run the container job on a runner with direct registry access
rejected_alternatives.reason: moves the trust boundary outside the approved environment; not the ratified route

rejected_alternatives.option: substitute a different or FROM-scratch base image
rejected_alternatives.reason: PROHIBITED - would invalidate the P3E supply-chain evidence

authoritative_digests.note: These upstream multi-arch INDEX digests are the ratified reference and are NOT changed by this decision. They remain exactly as pinned in deployment/governance-studio/base-images.json and in the Dockerfile FROM lines. The mirror is a transport, not a new source of truth.

mirror.credential_mechanism: normal CI secret mechanism (GitHub Actions repository/organization secrets); no credential is committed to the repository, printed in logs, or baked into any image layer

stop_condition.check: for each image, the manifest digest resolved from the mirror must equal the ratified upstream manifest_digest above, byte for byte
stop_condition.on_mismatch: halt the container job, execute no gate, mark nothing passed, and escalate to the owner; do not re-pin base-images.json or the Dockerfile to the mirrored digest
stop_condition.rationale: a differing digest means the mirrored image is not the ratified image; accepting it would silently substitute the base image this decision exists to prevent

prohibited: altering the upstream digests recorded above or in deployment/governance-studio/base-images.json
re-pinning the Dockerfile to a mirror-specific digest
marking any container gate passed without a real build
reporting a NOT_EXECUTED gate as passed, skipped, waived, or not applicable

gates_unblocked_when_mirror_available.note: Gate identifiers are carried forward exactly as recorded in the P3E audit; this decision does not redefine them. The two P3E records differ on whether C16-image and C17-image are listed, so both spellings are retained here and reconciled when the gates actually execute.

execution_preconditions: mirror registry host and repository prefix recorded in this file
pull credentials available to CI through the normal secret mechanism
a container runtime (daemon + buildx) available to the job
mirrored manifest digests verified equal to the ratified upstream digests
